hoaxes.title: OpenAI lets ChatGPT users earn extra GPT-6.2 usage by rating other people's chats
hoaxes.truth: Made up. OpenAI fixed a GPT-6.2 billing error, so users now reach limits 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol.

hoaxes.title: Macy's adds a giant inflatable weather vane to the 100th parade to warn balloon handlers about wind
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The 100th Macy's parade moved to Saturday, November 28, after forecast gusts topped the 34 mph balloon limit.

hoaxes.title: Mario Kart World update adds a track where players race around the inside of a Switch 2 dock
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Mario Kart World's free 1.9.0 update adds eight remixed tracks, including DK Pass 2 and Wario Stadium 2.

hoaxes.title: X's parental controls let parents swap a teen's timeline for cat photos after bedtime
hoaxes.truth: Made up. X's new parental controls let parents set daily limits and approve followers for teens, but not read their DMs.
